content.short: Pump.fun lets anyone launch and trade a Solana token in seconds using a bonding curve, with no presale or team allocation.
content.description: Pump.fun is a Solana token launchpad that collapses creation and trading into a single step. A new token starts on a bonding curve where price rises deterministically as supply is bought, so there is no presale, no team allocation, and no liquidity provisioning for the creator to arrange. If a token accumulates enough buying to complete the curve, its liquidity graduates to an automated market maker and trades normally from there. The design made memecoin issuance essentially frictionless and drove a large share of Solana's retail volume.
